text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: TRAAAIIIINEEEER-SAAAAAN!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I-I did it! I ran my debut race!
I saw it through all the way to the end!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! From here on, I'll rack up win after win
and become a full-fledged Umamusume. And eventually, even in GⅠ races—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops! My mistake!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall steadily do my best to get used to racing.
All in order to become the ideal princess I strive to be.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree, Trainer?!

In that debut race just now, Kawakami Princess looked far more relaxed
than she had during her mock races before.

Even if it's little by little like that.
If we train both her mind and body,
it should definitely lead to a good race.
And someday—
choice_data_list: Let's make you the greatest princess ever!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

And so, on the way back from
Hanshin Racecourse with Kawakami Princess—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess-sa~n!
Do you have a moment to spare right now?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No, we were just about to head home!
So I must decline your invitation for tea, you see.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
! Oh my, is that so!?
Well then, please, go right ahead. I am all ears.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much.
Her running was so powerful, but
she has such a charming personality, too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, my! Would you praise me even more!?
choice_data_list: I can't stay long, so please start with your questions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Haha, then I'll cut straight to the chase.
"What is your target for the next race?"
I assume you're aiming for the Hanshin JF or the Asahi Hai FS...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: None whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh... And what do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My goal for this year is to 'get used to racing'! But when the time comes, I'll go all out anywhere with no warm-up at all!!
choice_data_list: ...So, we won't narrow down our target races.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see. By the way, concretely speaking, what timing would you consider to be "when the time comes"?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... That would be—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: When would that be, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My oh my, I'm all fired up now!
Keep both of your eyes peeled and
enjoy witnessing my grand performance~!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! What truly delightful people.
Thank you very much for your comments!
—A few days later, in the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Editorial Pick: The charging, headlong princess!
No prep, straight to race day! Target race kept secret."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...W-Whoaa!
There's a comment addressed to me in the newspaper...!
It wasn't on the front page or even a featured article—just a tiny blurb in the corner. Yet Kawakami Princess couldn't stop dancing with joy at the sight of the newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I shall gain more and more
race experience and become a true princess!

"First, enter multiple races
to gain more fans while getting used to racing.
That way, you won't tense up unnaturally on any stage."
"—Let's nurture her mind and body, step by step."
